proposed_widenings.name: Condition: "charmed"
proposed_widenings.justification: The save_gate on-fail result applies the Charmed condition. The current Condition type only permits "prone". Mass Suggestion's core mechanic (WIS save → Charmed) requires charmed in the closed enum.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration"

proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection fixed-count mode
proposed_widenings.justification: Mass Suggestion targets up to 12 creatures with a fixed ceiling, not slot-scaled. The existing choose_up_to mode requires SlotScaling<number>. Encoding with perSlotAboveBase: 0 would be semantically dishonest. A new mode (e.g. choose_up_to_fixed with a plain number) or a union variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You suggest a course of activity...to twelve or fewer creatures you can see within range"

proposed_widenings.name: Duration slot-scaling (threshold tiers on timed duration)
proposed_widenings.justification: At higher slot levels the duration jumps non-linearly: base 24 hours, L7→10 days, L8→30 days, L9→366 days. The current Duration type has no slot-scaled or threshold-tiered timed variant. A new Duration shape (e.g. { kind: "timed_slot_scaled"; base: DurationValue; tiers: [...] }) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The duration is longer with a spell slot of level 7 (10 days), 8 (30 days), or 9 (366 days)."

proposed_widenings.name: Damage-breaks-condition expiry
proposed_widenings.justification: The Charmed condition ends early when the caster or allies deal damage to the target. This is a conditional expiry on an applied condition not expressible via the current apply_condition atom or any Duration/expiry surface shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target"

notes: Mass Suggestion fits the activation/save_gate family cleanly in structure — no new family or v4 atom is required. All four blockers are surface-level variants: charmed is missing from Condition, choose_up_to lacks a fixed-count mode, timed Duration has no slot-scaled/threshold-tiered variant, and apply_condition has no damage-breaks expiry hook. The v4 atom set (save_gate, apply_condition, persist, expire) would cover the mechanics once the surface types are widened. No Dhall/JSON produced per protocol.
